summary: Lucidchart Enterprise license request: SCIM, SSO, org-mapping and renewal alignment
justification: Design and Product teams need collaborative diagramming to replace multiple ad-hoc tools. Consolidation to Lucidchart Enterprise with SCIM and SSO reduces admin overhead, improves data access controls, and enables org-level sharing policies. Current ad-hoc spend on freelancers and external accounts is fragmented and risks IP leakage.
acceptance_criteria: SSO via Okta (SAML) configured and tested for Redwood domain
SCIM provisioning enabled and able to sync 3 groups: Product, Design, Platform
Org-level templates and external sharing restrictions configured per security policy
Finance has a purchase order or invoice matching agreed quote
Legal has signed master services agreement or approved click-through
Admin seats assigned and onboarding docs created for IT and team leads
steps_to_provision: Procurement to confirm final quote and PO number
Legal to review vendor T&Cs and execute MSA or approve standard terms
Finance to issue PO and confirm payment terms (Net30 preferred)
Identity team to exchange metadata and test SAML SSO in staging
Identity team to enable SCIM using service account and test user/group sync
IT to configure org settings, templates, and sharing policies
Support to run a pilot with 10 users for 2 weeks and collect feedback
Rollout to remaining 30 seats after pilot sign-off
description:
Issue summary:
Request to purchase and onboard Lucidchart Enterprise for centralized diagramming across Product, Design, and Platform. Impact:
- Current teams using multiple free/paid accounts with inconsistent controls.
- Admin burden on IT for manual seat provisioning.
- Need org-level templates and external sharing guardrails.
Environment:
- Redwood prod identity (Okta) and provisioning APIs available.
Requirements and ask:
1) Procure 40 editor seats (12-month term) with SCIM provisioning and SAML SSO.
2) Align renewal to Redwood fiscal cycle (Jul 1) if possible or negotiate prorated term.
3) Obtain an invoice/PO and add to ENG-TOOLS-2026 accounting code.
4) Legal approval of vendor terms or acceptance of standard online agreement.
Timeline:
- Target pilot start: 2026-03-16
- Pilot completion / decision: 2026-03-30
- Full rollout: by 2026-04-15
Notes on negotiation:
- Initial quote is $8,400/year for 40 editors; request 10% discount for org-wide consolidation and multi-year commit.
- Ask vendor for SCIM implementation support hours included in onboarding.
Security considerations:
- Must restrict external sharing by default and require admin approval for public links.
- SCIM identity sync must only provision users into permitted groups, no elevation of privileges via SCIM attributes.
- Data residency: confirm export and retention policies for legal.
Next steps:
- Procurement to confirm quote and create PO.
- Legal to check DPA and MSA.
- Identity to schedule SAML/SCIM integration window.
